scripts.build:actual: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace=@workspace/noviatify && npm run build --workspace=@workspace/api-server && rm -rf artifacts/api-server/dist/public && cp -r artifacts/noviatify/dist/public artifacts/api-server/dist/public
scripts.build:standalone: npm run build --workspace=@workspace/noviatify && npm run build --workspace=@workspace/api-server && rm -rf artifacts/api-server/dist/public && cp -r artifacts/noviatify/dist/public artifacts/api-server/dist/public
